header:
D3 P-1475 Domestic Abuse
Notice of Decision Made
text:
Decision maker: City Treasurer and Interim Deputy Chief Executive
Date of decision: 6 August 2026
What is the decision?: The appointment of a Provider to provide Domestic Abuse - Intersecting Needs Safe Accommodation.
Reasons for the decision (but excluding any exempt or confidential information): The proposed award of this contract follows a mini competition undertaken through the Housing Related Support Framework. This commission has been developed in response to unmet need identified through the Council's Domestic Abuse Needs Assessment and Domestic Abuse Strategy, with particular attention to victims and survivors whose experience of domestic abuse is compounded by complex or intersecting support needs. The award of this contract will provide specialist safe accommodation and support for victims and survivors with intersecting needs. A Key Decision is required because the maximum potential contract value exceeds £500,000 and the service is expected to have a significant impact on communities living and/or working across two or more wards within Manchester.
Alternatives considered and rejected: Insourcing was considered but rejected due to the specialist nature of the service, which requires expertise in delivering domestic abuse-informed support alongside accommodation for individuals and families with multiple and often complex support needs. The council would not be able to satisfactorily deliver the requirements needed. External delivery by a specialist provider was considered the most appropriate delivery model.
Interests Declared: None
